# JCN Space Agent

> Justyn Clark Network browser-first AI workspace runtime for spaces, tools, widgets, music workflows, and local project operations.

JCN Space Agent is the JCN-owned Space Agent source tree. The browser app is the primary runtime; the Node.js side exists mainly for page shells, auth, app-file APIs, outbound fetch proxying, local development, and optional desktop hosting. The repo is modular, layered, and designed for documentation-first agent development through `AGENTS.md` contracts and plain-text `SKILL.md` files.

Use `llms-full.txt` for the longer project description. Use the README for local run instructions, and use the AGENTS docs when you need the ownership and architecture map that guides changes in this repository.

## Project

- [JCN Space Agent full context](https://github.com/justyn-clark/space-agent/blob/main/server/pages/llms-full.txt): Expanded project summary derived from the current README and runtime contracts.
- [GitHub README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justyn-clark/space-agent/main/README.md): Local setup, development, desktop packaging, and documentation entry points.
- [Repo-wide AGENTS contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justyn-clark/space-agent/main/AGENTS.md): Documentation map, ownership rules, and top-level architecture.

## Source And Releases

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/justyn-clark/space-agent): JCN-owned source repository.
- [Latest desktop release](https://github.com/justyn-clark/space-agent/releases/latest): JCN-owned desktop release channel when published.

## Local Runtime

- `npm run dev -- PORT=0 CUSTOMWARE_PATH="$HOME/.jcn/space-agent/customware" SINGLE_USER_APP=true`: fastest local development launch.
- `node space serve PORT=0 CUSTOMWARE_PATH="$HOME/.jcn/space-agent/customware" SINGLE_USER_APP=true`: direct local server launch.
- `node space supervise HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 CUSTOMWARE_PATH="$HOME/.jcn/space-agent/customware"`: production-style source checkout supervisor.
